claims.statement: Changeset Templates set failOnError (stop or suppress and continue) in generated changesets.
claims.supports: failOnError: stop the update on error, or suppress it and continue

claims.statement: Changeset Templates set runOnChange (rerun a modified changeset or throw and stop).
claims.supports: runOnChange: rerun a modified changeset, or throw an exception and stop

claims.statement: Create Preconditions adds preconditions to generated changesets with on-fail HALT, CONTINUE, MARK_RAN or WARN.
claims.supports: Create Preconditions ... HALT, CONTINUE, MARK_RAN, or WARN

claims.statement: An option adds an empty rollback to changesets whose change type has no automatic rollback.
claims.supports: option to add an empty rollback to changesets whose change type lacks automatic rollback

claims.statement: Cross-DB types use Liquibase properties with dbms (e.g. ${string.type}) so one changelog serves several DBMS.
